title: Parameter initialisation
description: Mean over 5 fixed-seed 10-asset, K=5, q=0.5 instances (no sector cap or target, zero costs), est window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30. Standard mixer, p = 3, COBYLA.
x_label: Initialisation (0 = Random init, 1 = Ramp init, 2 = INTERP warm start)
notes: INTERP is the declared warm start: optimise at p = 1 from the ramp, then extend one depth at a time by interpolating the parameters; the evaluation budget is split equally across depths.
Synthetic subset of NIFTY 50 tickers; estimation window 2023-10-01..2025-09-30
5 instance(s) with seeds [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], QAOA seed = instance seed, maxiter 60, 4096 shots; yerr is the sample standard deviation over instances.
